raw_text: DISCLOSURE: Critical vulnerability found in Indian Railways Electronic Interlocking signaling systems integrated with KAVACH. The integration layer uses unencrypted serial communication channels that could allow unauthorized signal manipulation. Affects 4,500+ stations. Responsible disclosure made to Railway Board. Emergency patching of Class A routes initiated. #RailwaySafety #KAVACH
clean_text: Critical vulnerability disclosed in Indian Railways Electronic Interlocking systems integrated with KAVACH. Unencrypted serial channels could allow signal manipulation across 4,500+ stations.
